_comment: Which constraints apply to which way of obtaining a thing.
This exists to keep 'not applicable' and 'unknown' apart. Both render as a
null, and only this file says which kind of null it is. Getting it wrong in
either direction is bad: claiming 'unknown' for something with no restriction
badges every result with a warning nobody can ever clear, and claiming 'not
applicable' for something we simply haven't sourced hides a real gap.
A method is only listed here when there is a source for the claim. Anything
absent defaults to 'unknown', which is the safe direction.
SOURCES
- fishing/diving/fish_trap: time of day has no effect on fishing in Fields of
Mistria. Corroborated by the wiki carrying a `time` column for Bugs and none
for Fish anywhere — not in Cargo, not in the fish infobox, not in the fish
list table — plus community fishing guides stating it directly.
Checked 2026-08-07 against fieldsofmistria.wiki.gg and Steam guides.
- crop_harvest: a planted crop is harvestable whenever it is ready; the game
has no harvest window. Weather does not gate harvesting either.
- shop: shops do not close. You can buy until 2am, when the player passes out
— which is the end of the game day, so there is no time restriction inside
the day at all. Reported by the project owner from play, 2026-08-07.
NOTE: this is about the TIME axis only. Day-of-week restrictions are real
and separate — the Saturday Market is Saturdays, and Balor's Wagon rotates.
Those belong in a window's `days`, not here.
NOT listed, deliberately: bug_net and foraging. Bugs demonstrably have time
windows (the wiki has a `time` column for them), and forageable timing has not
been checked. Both stay 'unknown' until D2/D3 sources them.
WHERE A METHOD HAPPENS, when the method itself settles it.
`locationByMethod` is not an inference and not a default. It is for the one
case where the way you obtain a thing IS the place: a crop grows where you
planted it, and the Farming page gives exactly two options — tilled soil on
the player's farm, and a greenhouse, which is a building constructed on the
player's farm. Both are `the_farm`. Checked 2026-08-07.
Nothing else belongs here. `foraging` happens in eight different regions and
`dig_spot` in most of them; filling those from a rule would be exactly the
invented data this project refuses to carry. They stay gaps.
